verdict.rationale: Isaac is a developer platform with Python and ROS 2 programmatic interfaces, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask. However, the pack documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The Python packages and ROS 2 services are programming interfaces, not a downloadable machine-readable spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
